stories.title: What drove last week's volatile market: Fed decision meets Big Tech earnings
stories.summary: Markets swung last week as investors digested a Federal Reserve policy decision alongside a wave of Big Tech earnings reports. The combination of monetary policy signals and corporate results whipsawed major indexes, according to CNBC's recap.
stories.whyItMatters: Understanding which catalyst — Fed policy or earnings — is driving price action helps investors gauge whether volatility is likely to persist or fade.
whatToWatch: Follow-through reaction in tech shares as earnings season continues
Any shift in Fed rhetoric at upcoming public appearances
questions: Which factor, the Fed or earnings, had the larger net effect on index moves?
Does volatility carry into the coming week?

stories.title: A 75-year-old worries about letting a $1 million retirement fund dip lower
stories.summary: A MarketWatch reader in their mid-70s expressed anxiety about their retirement portfolio falling below the $1 million mark, prompting a broader discussion of whether such caution is warranted at that stage of life.
stories.whyItMatters: The piece highlights a common tension for retirees between preserving principal and drawing down savings to fund a comfortable retirement.
questions: What withdrawal rate and asset allocation would ease this reader's concerns?
How do longevity risk and market risk factor into the advice given?

stories.title: Report touts three lesser-known bond ETFs paying over 10% monthly
stories.summary: A Yahoo Finance piece spotlights three bond exchange-traded funds that reportedly offer monthly yields exceeding 10%, arguing most income-focused investors are unaware of them.
stories.whyItMatters: High-yield income products can be attractive in a income-starved environment, but yields well above market norms often come with elevated risk that readers should scrutinize.
whatToWatch: Underlying credit quality and duration risk of the funds mentioned
Whether such high monthly payouts are sustainable or partly return of capital
questions: What are the actual names and holdings of the three ETFs?
Are the double-digit yields net of fees and sustainable long-term?

stories.title: Berkshire Hathaway shares touch an eight-month high

stories.whyItMatters: As a bellwether conglomerate spanning insurance, railroads, and equities, Berkshire's stock performance is often read as a proxy for broader market and economic confidence.

Any upcoming Berkshire disclosures or portfolio moves
questions: What specifically drove shares to this eight-month high?

Eli Lilly's report for signals on pharma/weight-loss drug momentum

stories.title: Thousands gather in Amsterdam for WorldPride amid heightened security after Berlin attack
stories.summary: Large crowds turned out in Amsterdam for WorldPride celebrations, taking place under a heavier security presence following a recent attack in Berlin, according to Investing.com.

questions: What specific security measures were put in place in response to the Berlin attack?

stories.title: Reader warns others after paying $185 to a fake passport website
stories.summary: A MarketWatch reader recounted losing $185 to what they believed was an official passport renewal site, seeking advice on whether a refund is possible.
stories.whyItMatters: The case is a reminder for consumers to verify official government sites before making payments, especially amid a rise in look-alike scam websites.
whatToWatch: Guidance on disputing charges through the reader's bank or card issuer
Any regulatory action against the fraudulent site operators
questions: Was the reader able to recover any of the funds?
What official channels exist to report and shut down such scam sites?

stories.title: Longer lifespans are straining a retirement system built for shorter ones
stories.summary: A MarketWatch piece argues that rising U.S. life expectancy is outpacing the assumptions baked into retirement savings and Social Security systems, leaving many Americans financially unprepared for longer lives.
stories.whyItMatters: Longevity risk is a growing concern for retirement planning, pension funding, and Social Security solvency debates that affect millions of investors.
whatToWatch: Any policy proposals to shore up Social Security funding
Shifts in how financial advisors model retirement horizons
questions: What specific reforms does the piece suggest to address the mismatch?
